This package contains an adapted copy of the Apache-2.0
`ComfyUI-VDN-H3` 1.5.2 integration by Saganaki22, which ports the official
OpenVDN VDN-H3 implementation to ComfyUI.

Star7 changes the Python namespace, user-facing node, model discovery UX,
logging, and compatibility behavior with the Star7 H3 chunk node. The
upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in `LICENSE-ComfyUI-VDN-H3`.

Upstream projects:

- https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-VDN-H3
- https://github.com/OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3
